name: Ramesh Kuppili
headline: Founder & CEO | Ayatas Technologies, Empowering Global Brands with High-Performance B2B, B2C & D2C eCommerce & Software Solutions | Shopify, Woo Commerce & Magento Expert | Digital Transformation Partner
about:
I'm a passionate entrepreneur and technology leader with over 18 years of experience guiding organizations through AI-driven digital transformation.

In 2008, I started Ayatas Technologies with a simple belief — technology should not just support businesses, it should accelerate them.

What began as a small vision has grown into a global digital solutions company helping B2B and B2C enterprises transform, scale, and compete in fast-evolving markets. As Founder & CEO, my journey has been driven by curiosity, resilience, and a deep passion for solving complex business problems through technology.

Over the years, I’ve worked closely with entrepreneurs, growing brands, and enterprise teams who were facing challenges — outdated systems, underperforming eCommerce platforms, disconnected workflows, or limited scalability. Instead of offering generic solutions, we built tailored strategies powered by AI, automation, and intelligent architecture.

Our expertise across Custom eCommerce development and platforms like Magento, Shopify, and WooCommerce has allowed us to deliver high-performing eCommerce ecosystems that go beyond just “online stores.” We focus on performance, user experience, integration, and long-term scalability — because digital success isn’t about launching a website, it’s about building sustainable growth.

For me, leadership is not just about managing a company — it’s about building a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement. I believe in staying hands-on, understanding every client’s vision, and ensuring technology aligns with business outcomes.

Today, Ayatas Technologies stands as a trusted digital transformation partner, and I remain committed to helping businesses unlock their full potential through intelligent, scalable, and future-ready solutions.

If you're looking for a technology partner who values strategy, innovation, and long-term impact — let’s connect.

… more

experiences.description:
Founded and scaled Ayatas Technologies into a full-service digital transformation agency, helping B2B and B2C brands build, optimize, and scale high-performing digital platforms.

Specialize in customer-centric eCommerce solutions, Real Estate IT Solutions, eLearning platforms, SaaS product development, conversion optimization, and technology-driven growth systems focused on measurable business outcomes.

Built and led cross-functional teams across custom software, SaaS engineering, eCommerce platforms, UI/UX, digital marketing, automation, and analytics. Partnered with founders and marketing leaders to align technology, design, and growth strategy while leading digital transformation initiatives that improved revenue performance, customer experience, and operational efficiency.

Architected and delivered custom eCommerce, SaaS, and web platforms optimized for performance, scalability, UX, and conversions. Led WooCommerce, Magento, and Shopify builds, redesigns, migrations, and optimization initiatives, including headless and API-first architectures. Developed custom integrations connecting platforms with CRMs, ERPs, marketing automation tools, analytics, and third-party services.

Designed and implemented Real Estate IT solutions including property platforms, CRM integrations, lead management, dashboards, and reporting systems. Led development of custom eLearning and LMS platforms supporting course management, assessments, certifications, payments, and analytics.

Drove conversion-focused UI/UX strategies, embedded SEO and CRO best practices into platform architecture, and implemented analytics frameworks for data-driven optimization. Designed automation and AI-powered workflows reducing manual operations and improving decision-making.

Served as a long-term technology and growth partner for startups, SMBs, and enterprises across eCommerce, SaaS, real estate, and eLearning, delivering scalable systems, strong client retention, and consistent business growth.
